report.summary: Chunk defines env_center, IGNORE_PRESETS, expand_presets, project_scope, effective_rules. Verifies claims about env var, preset expansion, precedence, ordering.
risks: env_center | low | Returns empty tuple for missing env var; caller may misinterpret empty center. | Confirm callers handle empty center correctly.
expand_presets | low | Unknown @name passed through silently; may hide typos. | Add warning log for unknown presets.
project_scope | medium | .daedalusignore file loading is uncheckable; claim about file existence unverifiable. | Check load_ignore_rules implementation.
effective_rules | high | DAEDALUS_IGNORE env var parsed by env_extra_patterns which is uncheckable; may differ from documented behavior. | Review env_extra_patterns function.

handoff.purpose: Defines env_center, IGNORE_PRESETS, expand_presets, project_scope, effective_rules, and docstring claims about ignore rule composition.

symbols.name: env_center
symbols.note: Reads DAEDALUS_CENTER env var, splits by os.pathsep, normalizes via _norm_center.

symbols.name: IGNORE_PRESETS
symbols.note: Dictionary mapping preset names to tuples of glob patterns for test files.

symbols.name: expand_presets
symbols.note: Replaces @name entries with preset patterns, preserves order, passes unknown names through.

symbols.name: project_scope
symbols.note: Resolves ProjectScope using center (arg or env) and composed ignore rules from file, env, and extra_ignore.

symbols.name: effective_rules
symbols.note: Combines file rules with DAEDALUS_IGNORE env patterns, env wins on ties.

claims.why: Function reads DAEDALUS_CENTER, splits on os.pathsep, returns tuple of roots.

claims.text: Replace ``@name`` entries with their preset patterns, order preserved.
claims.why: Code iterates patterns, checks membership in IGNORE_PRESETS, extends out list preserving order.

claims.text: An unknown ``@name`` is passed through untouched rather than dropped: a silent no-op would look exactly like a preset that did nothing.
claims.why: If s not in IGNORE_PRESETS and s is not empty, it is appended as-is.

claims.text: ``center`` precedence: explicit argument (project config / CLI flag) over ``DAEDALUS_CENTER``.
claims.why: Code uses _norm_center(center) if center else env_center(), so explicit arg overrides env.

claims.text: Ignore rules compose in a fixed order -- center says which tree is yours, ignore carves exceptions *within* it: .daedalusignore  ->  DAEDALUS_IGNORE  ->  extra_ignore (project config). Later wins, because ``matches()`` is last-match-wins.
claims.why: The claim about .daedalusignore loading and matches() behavior is not verifiable from this chunk; those functions are defined elsewhere.

claims.text: That ordering lets a project config re-include something the repo file excluded (``!path``), which is the only way a shared repo file and a per-project override can coexist.
claims.why: Depends on matches() implementation not present in this chunk.

claims.text: File rules plus ``DAEDALUS_IGNORE``, in that order (env wins on tie).
claims.why: Code loads base via load_ignore_rules, then appends env patterns; last-match-wins means env overrides.

observations.what: env_center returns empty tuple when DAEDALUS_CENTER is missing or blank; no fallback.
expand_presets passes unknown @name through without warning; potential silent misconfiguration.
project_scope calls effective_rules which loads .daedalusignore file via load_ignore_rules; file existence not checked in this chunk.
effective_rules calls env_extra_patterns which is not defined in this chunk; behavior unknown.
